title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཚ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 97)
shelf_note: Authentic canonical Madhyamaka treatise from the Derge Tengyur (volume ཚ, folio 255).

ocr_errors.problem: extraneous hash symbol in transcription at line wrap

tr_errors_A.english: In the ultimate sense, the views and other attributes belonging to Devadatta are not the appropriated objects... because they are views and so forth. For example, they are just like the nature of the views belonging to Yajnadatta.
tr_errors_A.problem: Mistranslates 'lta ba' (darśana, visual perception / seeing) as philosophical 'views' in the context of the six sense faculties.

tr_errors_A.english: because you still describe the self as the owner
tr_errors_A.problem: Translates 'bdag gi' (of the self / ātmatva) loosely as 'the owner' (svāmin/bdag po).

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B correctly translates 'lta ba' (darśana) as sensory seeing rather than philosophical views, supplies accurate technical Sanskrit glosses, and faithfully preserves the trailing incomplete clause at the folio boundary.

book_verdict: Clear, authentic woodblock folio from the Derge Tengyur containing Madhyamaka commentary on Mūlamadhyamakakārikā chapter 9, accurately transcribed.
